source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 28.4 with Quick Check 28.2 answered, printed pages 178-180 (PDF 181-183). The peak chromatogram and GC-MS note are our aids.

blocks.text: Gas chromatography (GC) gases, volatile (jaldi bhaap banne wale) liquids aur solids (gas ki shakal mein) alag karne ke liye istemal hoti hai. GC mein stationary phase aik non-volatile (bhaap na banne wala), lambi chain wala, non-polar hydrocarbon liquid hai jis ka boiling point ooncha hai; yeh silica (SiO₂) ya alumina (Al₂O₃) ke chhote particles se juda hota hai. GC mein mobile phase aik inert gas (react na karne wali gas), yani carrier gas, hai jaise helium ya nitrogen. Sample injector port mein dala jata hai, jahan oven usay foran bhaap bana deta hai. Carrier gas sample ki bhaap ko aik lambe, lipte hue (coiled) column se guzaarti hai jo silica ke nanhe particles se bhara hota hai; in ki surface area bohat bari hoti hai aur isi par components alag hote hain.

Mixture ke non-polar substances stationary phase ke particles par lage non-polar liquid se zyada interaction (mel jol, kashish) rakhte hain, is liye column se aahista guzarte hain. Yani jo cheezein zyada mazbooti se interact karti hain woh aahista chalti hain aur baqi tez, aur yun alag ho jati hain. Alag hui cheezein column se nikal kar detector se guzarti hain, jo unhein pehchan kar aik graph par peaks ki shakal mein record (darj) karta hai; is graph ko chromatogram kehte hain. Detector har component ka retention time bhi record karta hai. Kisi substance ko column se guzarne mein jo waqt lagta hai woh us ka retention time hai.

blocks.alt: Carrier gas (mobile phase) injector port par dakhil hoti hai jahan sample dala jata hai, injector oven mein. Column oven mein lipta column (1-5 m lamba, 3-6 mm diameter) detector oven mein detector aur phir exit tak jata hai; detector se taar computer ya recorder tak jate hain jo peaks dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Carrier gas sample ki bhaap ko lipte hue (coiled) column se guzaarti hai. Detector har component ko peak ki shakal mein computer ya recorder ko bhejta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is aik diagram ke neeche do captions chhapti hai: 'Figure 28.6 Gas Chromatography' aur 'Figure 28.5 Gas chromatography'. Yeh aik hi figure hai, is liye yahan sirf Figure 28.5 likha gaya hai.

Gas chromatography ki sensitivity (bohat thori miqdar bhi pakar lena) zyada hai, resolution (components ko saaf alag karna) achha hai, analysis tez hai aur quantification (miqdar napna) accurate hai. Gases ka mixture GC se room temperature par aasani se alag ho jata hai. GC quantitative (miqdar napne wali) technique bhi hai. Pehle peaks pehchani jati hain, phir har peak ka area napa jata hai, jo mixture mein har component ka hissa batata hai. Peaks taqreeban triangle (tikon) jaisi hoti hain, is liye peak ka area is formula se nikalta hai:

blocks.text_alt: Area of a peak = ½ × base × height

blocks.text: Teen esters A, B aur C ke mixture mein ester A ki percentage yeh hai:

blocks.latex: \%\ \text{of A} = \frac{\text{peak area of A}}{\text{sum of peak areas of A, B and C}} \times 100
blocks.text_alt: % of A = (peak area of A / sum of peak areas of A, B and C) × 100

blocks.alt: Chromatogram: retention time ke muqable detector ka response (jawab), teen triangle jaisi peaks A, B aur C; peak B par us ki base aur unchai (height) dikhayi gayi hai.
blocks.caption: Gas chromatogram ki peaks, base aur height (is lesson ke liye hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Agar peaks bohat patli hon ya un ki base ki width (chaurai) aik jaisi ho, to mixture mein components ka hissa andaza karne ke liye area ki jagah peak ki unchai (height) istemal hoti hai. GC se competing athletes (muqable mein hissa lene wale khilariyon) mein steroids ki maujoodgi check ki jati hai. Car racing mein istemal hone wale fuel (eendhan) ke components bhi isi se test kiye jate hain.

items: Industry mein GC quality control (maal ka mayaar check karna) aur environmental protection (mahol ki hifazat) ke liye bohat zaroori hai. Maslan petrochemical plants is se fuels ki composition (banawat) jaanchte hain, aur environmental samples mein organic pollutants ki bohat thori miqdar (trace amounts) bhi dhoondte hain.

Forensic laboratories legal investigations (qanooni tehqeeqat) mein evidence (saboot) dene ke liye GC par bohat bharosa karti hain. Is se aksar khoon mein alcohol ki miqdar (blood alcohol content, BAC) ka test hota hai. Is ke ilawa GC se biological samples (khoon, peshab waghera) mein ghair qanooni drugs, zehr ya performance barhane wali cheezein dhoondi jati hain.

Food aur beverage (khane aur peene ki cheezon ki) industry GC se apni cheezon ki consistency (har baar aik jaisa hona) aur safety yaqeeni banati hai. Bacteria ya fungi ke metabolic byproducts (un ke bane hue maadde) pehchan kar GC kharabi (spoilage) ko aankh se nazar aane se pehle hi pakar leti hai. GC se perfumes, essential oils aur khurak ke flavours ki complex aromatic profiles (khushbu ki banawat) bhi jaanchi jati hai.

Hospitals waghera (clinical settings) mein GC mareez ki saans ya peshab ke khaas compounds jaanch kar metabolic disorders (jism ke chemical kaamon ki bimariyan) ki diagnosis (bimari ki pehchan) karti hai. Dawa ki research mein bhi is se nayi banayi gayi dawaiyon ki purity check hoti hai, taa ke mareez tak pohnchne se pehle dawa mein koi harmful (nuqsan deh) bacha hua solvent ya impurity na rahe.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Forensic science mein chromatography ahem hai. China mein Nian Bin naam ke aik aadmi par 2005 mein ilzaam laga ke us ne do parosi bachchon ki khurak mein chooha maar zehr (aik fluoroacetate) mila kar unhein qatl kiya. Lekin 8 saal baad, 2013 mein, woh be-qasoor sabit hua aur rihaa kar diya gaya. Khurak ke sample ko gas chromatography se test kiya gaya, jis ne sabit kiya ke us mein zehr nahi mila tha.

items: GC sirf volatile (aasani se bhaap banne wali) cheezon ke liye kaam karti hai.
Samples thermally stable (garmi mein na tootne wale) hone chahiye. Jo compounds zyada temperature par toot jate hain, un par GC istemal nahi ho sakti.
Proteins aur polymers jaise bare biomolecules GC se nahi jaanche ja sakte kyunke yeh aasani se bhaap nahi bante.
GC ke instruments (aalaat) aur un ki maintenance (dekh bhaal) ka kharcha zyada hai.

blocks.title: GC mass spectrometry ke saath
blocks.text: Forensic kaam mein GC aksar mass spectrometer ke saath jori jati hai (GC-MS). Column se nikalne wala har component seedha mass spectrometer mein jata hai; us ka spectrum batata hai ke yeh kaun si cheez hai, aur peak ka area batata hai ke kitni hai, chahe miqdar bohat thori ho.

Lactic acid, CH₃CH(OH)COOH, ke aik impure (na-khalis) sample mein sirf butanone ki contamination (milawat) hai. Is mixture ko gas chromatography se jaancha jata hai. Kitab ke mutabiq butanone ka retention time lactic acid se zyada (longer) aata hai.

blocks.prompt: (i) Mobile aur stationary phase ke liye suitable (munasib) cheezein batayein.
blocks.explanation: Mobile phase: koi inert carrier gas, jaise helium ya nitrogen. Stationary phase: silica ya alumina ke particles par laga hua non-volatile, ooncha boiling point wala liquid (jaise lambi chain wala hydrocarbon).

blocks.prompt: (ii) Gas chromatogram se mixture ki percentage composition kaise maloom karenge?
blocks.explanation: Pehle retention time se peaks pehchanein. Har peak ka area napein (½ × base × height). Butanone ki % = butanone peak ka area ÷ (dono peaks ke areas ka jor) × 100; isi tarah lactic acid ki %.

items: GC: mobile phase = inert carrier gas (He, N₂); stationary phase = silica ya alumina par non-volatile liquid.
Retention time se component ki pehchan; peak ka area (½ × base × height) se us ki miqdar.
% of A = A ka peak area ÷ sab peaks ke areas ka jor × 100.
Sirf volatile aur garmi mein stable samples; forensics, industry, khurak aur medicine mein istemal.
